body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage, or 2 if that target has no cover bonus and already took Damage since its last turn.

surges.html: Suppress 1 point of equipment Fortitude for this attack.
On a hit, the target is Distracted until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Lock - Execution
rider.html: After a hit, you may end Lock on the target to prevent its next 1 unit of voluntary movement before your next turn.
